title: bolbitis gemmifer
intro: Bolbitis gemmifer, commonly known as the gem fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
